name: Hyundai Tucson
title: Hyundai Tucson Problems by Year: Years to Avoid and What Owners Report | Steer Me Right
description: Which Hyundai Tucson model years to buy used and which to skip, from NHTSA owner complaints per 100,000 sold, recalls by year, the engine and braking complaints and what owners report on Reddit.
h1: Hyundai Tucson problems by year: years to avoid and what owners report
card: The best and worst Tucson years, the 2016 to 2019 engine complaints, the 2025 braking recall, complaints per 100,000 sold and what owners report.
answer: The best used Tucsons are the 2020, 2021, 2023 and 2024 model years, which draw {r:2020}, {r:2021}, {r:2023} and {r:2024} NHTSA owner complaints per 100,000 sold against a yardstick of {base} for this car. Skip the 2016 to 2019 and the 2022. The 2016 and 2017 are far above anything else ({r:2016} and {r:2017}), with the engine named in {k:2016:ENGINE} and {k:2017:ENGINE} complaints; the 2018 ({r:2018}) and 2019 ({r:2019}) fall under the Avoid line on rate but carry the same engine pattern, so we rate them Avoid too. The 2022 draws {r:2022}, a point over the line, with the engine ({k:2022:ENGINE}) and the fuel system ({k:2022:FUEL/PROPULSION SYSTEM}) leading. The 2025 ({r:2025}) is Check first: {k:2025:FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE} of its {c:2025} complaints name automatic braking, which Hyundai’s free recall 26V-316 covers.

The rates divide each model year’s NHTSA complaints, counted across the gas, Hybrid and Plug-in Hybrid listings, by Hyundai’s U.S. Tucson sales; the release has one Tucson row and doesn’t say whether it includes the hybrids, whose complaints are in the count; if it doesn’t, the 2022 rate is overstated. The 2022 was the first year of the current generation and the 2016 the first of the one before. The 2026 is too new to rate and has six recalls. Our Tucson price guide covers what a new or used one costs.
salesNote: Sales come from Hyundai’s year-end releases and Good Car Bad Car’s Tucson table, the same figures our Tucson comparison pages use; 2016 to 2018 come from Good Car Bad Car alone.

2016: The highest rate of any year, {r:2016}. Power train ({k:2016:POWER TRAIN}), engine ({k:2016:ENGINE}) and structure ({k:2016:STRUCTURE}) lead. Recall 16V-628 covers dual-clutch transmission software, and 20V-543 a brake control unit fire risk.
2017: Engine complaints ({k:2017:ENGINE}) are the most for any part in any year. Recall 21V-727 covers connecting rod bearing wear that can damage the engine, and 20V-543 applies.
2018: The engine carries {k:2018:ENGINE} of {c:2018} complaints, mostly oil and knocking in the text we read, and no engine recall covers the 2018. Recall 20V-543 covers the brake control unit.
check to avoid: the engine carries 62% of the complaints, with no recall to explain them, and the 2016 and 2017 engines show the same pattern
2019: Engine again ({k:2019:ENGINE} of {c:2019}), then brakes ({k:2019:SERVICE BRAKES}). The rate sits ten points under the line to Avoid. Recall 20V-543 covers the brake control unit, whose fuse swap is a fire fix.
check to avoid: the engine carries 53% of the complaints, with no engine recall to explain them, and the rate is within ten points of the line
2020: Engine is {k:2020:ENGINE} of {c:2020} complaints, 42% of the total, so we’d still ask for service records. Recall 20V-543 (a brake control unit fuse) applies.
2021: The lowest rate in the table, {r:2021}, on {c:2021} complaints. Engine ({k:2021:ENGINE}) leads, and recall 20V-543 applies.
2022: The first year of the current generation: engine ({k:2022:ENGINE}) and the fuel system ({k:2022:FUEL/PROPULSION SYSTEM}) lead. Most fuel complaints we read name injectors with a warning light. The rate is one point over the line. Recalls cover roof moldings (23V-038) and headlight software (21V-938).
2023: {c:2023} complaints, spread across parts, none above {k:2023:UNKNOWN OR OTHER}. Recall 23V-526 covers an oil pump controller that can overheat.
2024: {c:2024} complaints, led by automatic emergency braking ({k:2024:FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE}). Four recalls apply, among them power steering circuit board 24V-412, which can cost steering assist.
2025: Automatic emergency braking is {k:2025:FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE} of {c:2025} complaints, and recall 26V-316 (camera software) covers it. Seven recalls apply, including 25V-549, where Hyundai replaces the engine.
2026: {c:2026} complaints and {rec:2026} recalls so far, including 25V-549 (engine replacement) and 26V-692 (front strut fasteners on the Hybrid). Too new to rate.

chartNote: The 2016 and 2017 bars are far taller than the rest. The 2022 bar is a first-generation-year spike, and nearly half of the 2025 bar is braking complaints.

generations.name: Third generation
generations.text: The TL Tucson went on sale in July 2015 as a 2016 with a 164-hp 2.0-liter and a 175-hp 1.6-liter turbo with a seven-speed dual-clutch transmission. The 2019 refresh dropped the dual-clutch and the manual for a six-speed automatic and replaced the turbo in most trims with a 181-hp 2.4-liter (Wikipedia).

generations.name: Fourth generation
generations.text: The redesigned Tucson is built in Montgomery, Alabama (Wikipedia). Hybrid and plug-in hybrid complaints appear in NHTSA’s files from 2022, and our Tucson price guide covers the current lineup.

problems.title: Engine, 2016 to 2019
problems.text: The engine is the leading part in 2017 ({k:2017:ENGINE}), 2018 ({k:2018:ENGINE}) and 2019 ({k:2019:ENGINE}). In the text we read, most mention oil, many mention knocking or stalling, and some mention a fire. Recall 21V-727 covers connecting rod bearing wear on 2017 cars; Hyundai inspects the engine, replaces it if bearings are damaged and installs knock-detection software, free. No recall covers the other years.

problems.title: Transmission, 2016
problems.text: The 2016 has {k:2016:POWER TRAIN} power train complaints, and about half the ones we read mention the transmission or clutch. Recall 16V-628 covers seven-speed dual-clutch software that can leave the car unable to move after repeated pedal presses; dealers update it, free.

problems.title: Brake control unit fire risk, 2016 to 2021
problems.text: Recall 20V-543 covers an anti-lock brake control unit that can corrode inside and short, which can start an engine compartment fire. Dealers replace a fuse, and on 2019 to 2021 cars update the stability control software, free. Our Tucson price guide says to confirm it is done.

problems.title: Fuel injectors on the 2022
problems.text: The 2022 has {k:2022:FUEL/PROPULSION SYSTEM} fuel system complaints, and most we read name fuel injectors and a warning light. No recall or investigation covers it, and NHTSA’s field says nothing about cause.

problems.title: Automatic braking, 2025 on
problems.text: Recall 26V-316 covers front camera software that can make the forward collision system brake unexpectedly on 2025 and 2026 Tucsons, Hybrids and Plug-in Hybrids; dealers update it, free. It accounts for most of the 2025’s {k:2025:FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE} braking complaints, and the 2026 has {k:2026:FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE} so far.

paragraphs: The oil-burning and engine-failure reports match the 2016 to 2019 engine counts in the table. The 2025 braking recall barely shows up, and the 2025 keyless and software reports fit its 131 electrical complaints.

notableRecalls.title: Connecting rod bolts
notableRecalls.text: Bolts that were tightened wrong can cost drive power and damage the engine, with an oil leak that can reach hot parts. Dealers replace the engine, free.

notableRecalls.title: Automatic braking software
notableRecalls.text: Front camera software may make the forward collision system brake early and unexpectedly. Dealers update the software, free. It covers the Hybrid and Plug-in Hybrid too.

notableRecalls.title: Front strut fasteners
notableRecalls.text: Strut fasteners that aren’t tight enough can cost steering control. Dealers tighten them and align the wheels, free.

notableRecalls.title: Brake control unit
notableRecalls.text: The anti-lock brake control unit can corrode and short, which can start an engine compartment fire. Dealers replace a fuse and, on 2019 to 2021 cars, update the stability control software, free.

notableRecalls.title: Connecting rod bearings
notableRecalls.text: Bearings can wear early and damage the engine, which can stall it or start a fire. Hyundai inspects the engine, replaces it if bearings are damaged and adds knock-detection software, free.

notableRecalls.title: Power steering circuit board
notableRecalls.text: The circuit board can short and leave the car without power steering assist. Dealers replace the electric power pack, free.

notableRecalls.title: Transmission control software
notableRecalls.text: Repeated accelerator presses in heat can leave the car unable to move. Dealers update the transmission control software, free.

notableRecalls.title: Idle stop-and-go oil pump
notableRecalls.text: The controller for the electric oil pump can overheat and start a fire. Owners are told to park outside until it is fixed; dealers replace the controller as needed, free.

noInvestigations: NHTSA’s public investigation list showed no investigation naming the Tucson on November 21, 2026.

checks.title: Brake control unit recall on a 2016 to 2021.
checks.text: Confirm 20V-543 is closed. It is a fire recall and the fix is a fuse, so a dealer can print the history in minutes.

checks.title: The engine on a 2016 to 2019.
checks.text: Ask for service records showing regular oil changes, check the dipstick, and listen for knocking on a cold start. On a 2017, confirm 21V-727 was done and ask whether the engine was ever replaced.

checks.title: Transmission on a 2016.
checks.text: Confirm 16V-628 on a dual-clutch car and ask the seller about hesitation or lurching in traffic.

checks.title: Engine replacement recall on a 2025 or 2026.
checks.text: Ask whether 25V-549 has been done; Hyundai replaces the engine on affected cars.

checks.title: Braking and display software on a 2025 or 2026.
checks.text: Confirm 26V-316 (braking) and 26V-400 (instrument display) are installed, and on a 2026 Hybrid 26V-692 too.

checks.title: An independent inspection.
checks.text: Reddit owners report oil burning on older turbo and 2.0-liter engines, keyless entry faults on 2025 cars and rear window trim that separates. Have a shop that isn’t the seller’s look at the engine and the trim before you sign.

newer: The 2026 Tucson has {c:2026} NHTSA complaints and {rec:2026} recalls so far, among them engine replacement recall 25V-549, so it is too early to call. If you are choosing between a new 2026 and a used 2023 or 2024, the used years have the lower complaint counts, and the 2024 has four recalls to confirm.
Our Tucson price guide has the 2026 prices, Hyundai’s incentives and our take on buying new.
faq: What is the worst Hyundai Tucson year?
The 2016, at {r:2016} NHTSA complaints per 100,000 sold, then the 2017 at {r:2017}. The engine and power train lead both, and the dual-clutch 2016 has a transmission software recall (16V-628).
What is the best used Tucson year?
The 2021 has the lowest rate, {r:2021}. The 2020, 2023 and 2024 are also Buy, at {r:2020}, {r:2023} and {r:2024}. Confirm recall 20V-543 on the 2020 and 2021.

It draws {r:2022} complaints per 100,000 sold, a point over our Avoid line, with the engine ({k:2022:ENGINE}) and the fuel system ({k:2022:FUEL/PROPULSION SYSTEM}) leading. It’s the first year of the current generation, and we’d choose a 2023 or 2024 instead.
Does the Hyundai Tucson have engine problems?

On the 2016 to 2019 it does: the engine is named in {k:2016:ENGINE}, {k:2017:ENGINE}, {k:2018:ENGINE} and {k:2019:ENGINE} complaints. Recall 21V-727 covers one 2017 failure, and Hyundai replaces the engine on affected 2025 and 2026 cars under 25V-549.
How do I check a used Tucson for recalls?
Enter the VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. It lists open recalls for that car, and recall repairs are free at a Hyundai dealer.
